title: Rectangular bar
spec:
Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. For the first face, begin with the first loop by drawing a line from the point (0.0, 0.0125) to (0.3444, 0.0125). Next, draw an arc starting at (0.3444, 0.0125), with a midpoint at (0.3312, 0.0438), and ending at (0.3444, 0.075). Continue with a line from (0.3444, 0.075) to (0.05, 0.075), followed by another line from (0.05, 0.075) to (0.05, 0.0625). Draw a line from (0.05, 0.0625) to (0.025, 0.0625), then another line from (0.025, 0.0625) to (0.025, 0.075). Add a line from (0.025, 0.075) to (0.0, 0.075), and finally, a line from (0.0, 0.075) back to (0.0, 0.0125). For the second loop, draw a circle centered at (0.1875, 0.0438) with a radius of 0.0094.

For the second face, start the first loop by drawing a line from (0.3444, 0.0125) to (0.4056, 0.0125). Draw an arc from (0.4056, 0.0125) with a midpoint at (0.4188, 0.0437) and ending at (0.4056, 0.075). Add a line from (0.4056, 0.075) to (0.3444, 0.075), and then an arc from (0.3444, 0.075) with a midpoint at (0.3312, 0.0438) and ending at (0.3444, 0.0125). For the second loop, draw a circle centered at (0.375, 0.0438) with a radius of 0.0125.

For the third face, draw the first loop by starting with an arc from (0.3444, 0.0125) with a midpoint at (0.375, 0.0) and ending at (0.4056, 0.0125). Add a line from (0.4056, 0.0125) back to (0.3444, 0.0125).

For the fourth face, draw the first loop by starting with an arc from (0.3444, 0.075) with a midpoint at (0.375, 0.0875) and ending at (0.4056, 0.075). Add a line from (0.4056, 0.075) back to (0.3444, 0.075).

For the fifth face, start the first loop by drawing a line from (0.4056, 0.0125) to (0.75, 0.0125). Add a line from (0.75, 0.0125) to (0.75, 0.075), followed by a line from (0.75, 0.075) to (0.7438, 0.075). Draw an arc from (0.7438, 0.075) with a midpoint at (0.7062, 0.0375) and ending at (0.6688, 0.075). Add a line from (0.6688, 0.075) to (0.4056, 0.075), and then an arc from (0.4056, 0.075) with a midpoint at (0.4188, 0.0437) and ending at (0.4056, 0.0125).

Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.75. Rotate the sketch using Euler angles set to zero degrees and translate it using a vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0188 units in the direction of the normal without extruding in the opposite direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar with a curved end and a hole are 0.75 units in length, 0.0875 units in width, and 0.01875 units in height.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0125) \
     .lineTo(0.3313, 0.0125) \
     .threePointArc((0.3594, 0.0), (0.3875, 0.0125)) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0125) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0875) \
     .lineTo(0.7375, 0.0875) \
     .threePointArc((0.6958, 0.0458), (0.6542, 0.0875)) \
     .lineTo(0.3875, 0.0875) \
     .threePointArc((0.3594, 0.075), (0.3313, 0.0875)) \
     .lineTo(0.0625, 0.0875) \
     .lineTo(0.0625, 0.075) \
     .lineTo(0.0438, 0.075) \
     .lineTo(0.0438, 0.0875) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0875) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0125) \
     .close()

# Add the circles
r = r.moveTo(0.1875, 0.0438).circle(0.0094)
r = r.moveTo(0.375, 0.0438).circle(0.0144)

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0188)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Main strip: 0.75 long (X), 0.0875 wide (Y), 0.0188 thick (Z)
strip = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.75, 0.0875, 0.0188, centered=(False, True, False))

# Central circular boss bulge
boss = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.375, 0.018)
    .circle(0.040)
    .extrude(0.0188)
)

part = strip.union(boss)

# Left small rectangular notch on top edge
notch = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.055, 0.04375)
    .rect(0.012, 0.010)
    .extrude(0.0188)
)
part = part.cut(notch)

# Large semicircular notch near right end (opening on top edge)
big_notch = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.695, 0.04375)
    .circle(0.022)
    .extrude(0.0188)
)
part = part.cut(big_notch)

# Small hole left of center
hole1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.215, 0.0)
    .circle(0.005)
    .extrude(0.0188)
)
part = part.cut(hole1)

# Center hole in the boss
hole2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.375, 0.0)
    .circle(0.007)
    .extrude(0.0188)
)
part = part.cut(hole2)

r = part

import cadquery as cq

# Create the base plate outline (top view profile)
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.344, 0.0) \
     .threePointArc((0.375, -0.0125), (0.406, 0.0)) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0625) \
     .lineTo(0.722, 0.0625) \
     .threePointArc((0.703, 0.04375), (0.684, 0.0625)) \
     .lineTo(0.406, 0.0625) \
     .threePointArc((0.375, 0.075), (0.344, 0.0625)) \
     .lineTo(0.03125, 0.0625) \
     .lineTo(0.03125, 0.055) \
     .lineTo(0.01875, 0.055) \
     .lineTo(0.01875, 0.0625) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0625) \
     .close()

# Extrude to the plate thickness
r = r.extrude(0.0188)

# Drill the two through holes
r = r.faces(">Z").workplane() \
     .moveTo(0.1875, 0.03125).hole(0.0125) \
     .moveTo(0.375, 0.03125).hole(0.015625)
